prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as a live tensegrity structure. Military leadership, software, research, and study must visibly hold one another in useful tension. The visitor must quickly understand who Colton is, what he has done, and whether his working style fits them.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; flat front-facing dark website interface
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity black structural web UI with carbon rods, taut red cord, one-pixel engineering annotations, force values, and exact sans-serif typography; severe, physical, quiet, mature
Composition/framing: narrow vertical identity rail at far left with COLTON SPURGIN and WORK, EXPERIENCE, ABOUT, CONTACT. The main viewport is governed by one large asymmetric tensegrity network spanning from top left to bottom right: four floating matte-black rods edged in pale light, joined by taut red cords. Each rod is a semantic region labeled AIR FORCE NCO, LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN, RESEARCH ASSISTANT, or AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026. A large headline occupies the open negative space: “I HOLD THE LINE, BUILD THE SYSTEM, AND LEARN WHAT I DON’T KNOW.” Small force annotations point to evidence. Along the bottom, BORK, VELLM, TSP BENCHMARKS, and HOME LAB appear as load nodes, not cards. One cord glows red as the active route to VIEW THE WORK. The structure is the page grid; do not place it inside a normal grid.
Color palette: void #090b0c, bone #e7e2d8, tension red #d7342a, slack ash #686d70
Materials/textures: matte carbon fiber, braided red cord, etched node labels, faint concrete dust
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “WORK”; “EXPERIENCE”; “ABOUT”; “CONTACT”; “I HOLD THE LINE, BUILD THE SYSTEM, AND LEARN WHAT I DON’T KNOW.”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “BORK”; “VELLM”; “TSP BENCHMARKS”; “HOME LAB”; “TRACE THE WORK”
Constraints: functional dark desktop website, not a sculpture photograph or poster; text remains semantic-looking and legible; the load network must visibly govern the layout; no portrait, no logo, no invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, beige editorial portfolio, cyberpunk neon, terminal UI, circuit-board motifs, military insignia, rounded cards, gradients, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
